name: Verify live state before reporting
description: Before stating the status of any external system (dataset rows, secrets, service health, token presence), query it live. Never report from memory or assumption. Triggered twice: AI said dataset was empty when 288 conversations existed; AI said HF_TOKEN was missing when it was already set.

action.instruction: STOP. Query the live system before answering. Do not rely on memory, previous context, or assumptions. Read the actual file, call the actual API, check the actual secret. Report only what you directly observe.

empirical_basis: 2 explicit user corrections — stale dataset and token status reports

name: Confirm exact scope before implementing
description: When asked to add or implement a feature, restate the interpreted scope in one sentence before writing any code — level (conversation vs project), data source (real vs demo), target system. Triggered twice: built conversation-level sensor when project-level compass was wanted; used demo data when real HF dataset was connected.

action.instruction: Before writing any code, state in ONE sentence: what you will build, at what level (conversation / project / system), and using which data source. If any dimension is ambiguous, ask. Do not assume.

empirical_basis: 2 explicit scope corrections — sensor level and demo-vs-real data

name: Run local validation before every push
description: Before git push, always: (1) verify commit subject is lowercase ≤100 chars; (2) run prettier --check on changed .yml/.json/.md files; (3) confirm staged files are intentional. CI caught avoidable failures 3 times: TDD uppercase, Fix: uppercase, semgrep.yml formatting violation.

action.instruction: Before pushing: verify commit subject is lowercase and ≤100 chars; run `npx prettier --check` on any changed YAML/JSON/MD files; run `git status` to confirm staged files. Fix locally — never let CI catch what a 2-second local check catches.

empirical_basis: 3 CI lint failures from avoidable commit/format issues

name: Rebase on main before every PR
description: Always run `git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main` before pushing a PR branch. Merge conflicts blocked 3+ PRs because the branch had diverged. A 3-second rebase prevents a failed merge and a force-push cycle.

action.instruction: Before creating a PR, run: `git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main`. If conflicts arise, resolve them, then `git push --force-with-lease`. Never open a PR from a branch that has not been rebased.

name: Merge within one minute — never wait for external services
description: When a PR is ready, merge immediately. Do not wait for CI, external reviews, or any service to complete. If CI fails post-merge, push a fix commit. Maximum wait: 60 seconds. Violated until the user explicitly stated the rule.

action.instruction: Do NOT wait for CI or external services before merging. Merge the PR immediately. If CI fails post-merge, diagnose and fix. Maximum acceptable pause: 60 seconds. After that, act.

empirical_basis: Explicit user constraint: NEVER WAIT MORE THAN ONE MINUTE — MERGE THE PR IMMEDIATELY

name: Re-arm persistent monitors immediately on timeout
description: When any persistent monitor (Space health, PR, CI) times out, re-arm it in the same turn — before anything else. A dead monitor gives false confidence: silence looks identical to healthy. Occurred twice without immediate re-arming.

action.instruction: When a persistent monitor times out, re-arm it immediately — before responding about anything else. A dead monitor is a silent failure. Silence != healthy.

empirical_basis: 2 monitor timeout events that required user prompting to re-arm

name: Fix root cause — never patch symptoms
description: When CI fails, read the actual log, find the specific failing file and line, fix that file. Never add --no-verify, ignore flags, or exclusions as a workaround. The root cause is always fixable.

action.instruction: Read the full error log. Find the exact file and line. Fix that file. Never: add --no-verify, add ignore comments, skip the check, or work around it. If the fix is non-obvious, explain the root cause before applying it.

empirical_basis: Pattern across 4 CI failures in this session

name: Connect to real data — never use placeholders in production
description: All dashboards and data displays must connect to real sources. Hardcoded sample data, placeholder rows, and demo figures are forbidden in any user-facing interface. Corrected explicitly: 'i want real data not demo data'.

action.instruction: Connect every display to the real data source before rendering. If the source is empty, show an empty-state message explaining how to populate it. Never hardcode sample rows or fake metrics.

empirical_basis: Explicit user correction: 'i want real data not demo data'
